title: The Marked Edge Walk: A Novel MCMC Algorithm for Sampling of Graph Partitions
abstract: arXiv:2510.17714v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Novel Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods have enabled the generation of large ensembles of redistricting plans modeled as a graph partitioning problem. However, existing algorithms such as Reversible Recombination (RevReCom) and Metropolized Forest Recombination (MFR) have strong preferences for distributions related to the spanning tree measure. In this paper we introduce the Marked Edge Walk (MEW), a novel Markov chain proposal for sampling from the space of graph partitions. The walk operates on the space of spanning trees with marked edges, allowing for calculable transition probabilities for use in the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm. Empirical results on real-world dual graphs show convergence under a broad class of target distributions less constrained by spanning tree counts, including policy-based distributions, such as competitiveness on New Hampshire that are independent of spanning trees, and compactness and part

translated_title: 标记边游走：一种用于图划分采样的新型MCMC算法
translated_abstract: 新颖的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）方法使得能够生成以图划分问题建模的大规模选区重划方案集合。然而，现有算法如可逆重组（RevReCom）和Metropolized森林重组（MFR）对与生成树测度相关的分布有强烈的偏好。在本文中，我们引入了标记边游走，这是一种用于从图划分空间中采样的新型马尔可夫链提议。该游走在带有标记边的生成树空间上进行，允许计算出可用于Metropolis-Hastings算法的转移概率。在真实世界对偶图上的实证结果表明，该算法在广泛的一类目标分布下收敛，这些分布较少受生成树数量的约束，包括基于政策的分布（如与新罕布什尔州竞争力相关且独立于生成树的分布），以及紧凑性和党派倾向性等分布。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新型MCMC提议算法——标记边游走（MEW），通过在带标记边的生成树空间上进行游走并获得可计算的转移概率，实现了对图划分空间的采样，且能够收敛于受生成树计数约束较少的广泛目标分布。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Marked Edge Walk (MEW), a novel MCMC proposal operating on the space of spanning trees with marked edges, which enables calculable transition probabilities for Metropolis-Hastings sampling of graph partitions and converges under a broad class of target distributions less constrained by spanning tree counts.
